pages.title: Different layout, Sample Hospital STP
pages.description: Sample Hospital STP, 100 KLD. Portrait page, 8 rows, readings at 08:00 and 20:00, 29 Sep to 2 Oct 2026. Columns are worded and ordered differently, with a sludge-volume column JalLog does not track and a signature column. It is another plant's page: use it to try the reader, then discard it.

recorded.label: Reading recorded on 4 Oct 2026 from gemini-3.5-flash
notes: The column 'Flow Meter Reading - Treated Water (m3/shift)' represents the volume of treated water discharged per shift, mapped to outletFlow.
The column 'Sludge Wasted (L)' is in Litres (volume) and does not map to sludgeKg (mass), so it is listed in unmappedColumns.

pages.title: One row a day, small plant meter register
pages.description: Sample Clinic STP, 10 KLD. One row a day, 21 Sep to 4 Oct 2026, no shifts and no lab values: flow meter readings, plant start and close time, lime, alum and chlorine dosing (written in g or kg), energy meter start and close readings, sludge, and a signature. Dates are written D-M-YY and one digit is overwritten. Written into it, as in the real register that shaped this plant kind: from 25 Sep the outlet reading is the same as the inlet reading on every row, and from 27 Sep the energy meter rises by exactly 3 on every row.
